brand.headline: Ship your admin panel, not the boilerplate.
brand.description: Authentication, RBAC, data tables, charts, theming and i18n — wired together and ready to extend.
brand.featureRbac: Route, menu and button level permissions
brand.featureTheme: Light, dark and five accent colors

title: Welcome back
subtitle: Sign in to continue to your workspace.
name: Full name
loginError: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and try again.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.description: One click fills the form. Each role sees a different permission set.
demo.adminHint: Full access, including deletes and demo reset.
demo.managerHint: Can create and edit users, but not delete them.
demo.viewerHint: Read-only access to the dashboard and users.
demo.disclaimer: Demo only. Client-side permissions are a UX layer, not a security boundary.

footer.demoNote: This demo runs entirely in your browser.

errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email address before signing in.
errors.inactive: This account is inactive. Contact an administrator.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.weakPassword: Use at least 8 characters with a letter and a number.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Start with read-only access. An admin can change your role later.
register.demoNote: Demo only: accounts and verification tokens stay in this browser.
register.successSubtitle: One last step before you can sign in.
register.sentTo: We sent a verification link to {{email}}.
register.demoToken: Demo mode exposes the verification token instead of sending email.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.subtitle: Confirm the address you used to register.
verify.sentTo: Click the button below to verify {{email}}.
verify.sentGeneric: Click the button below to verify your email address.
verify.verifiedFor: {{email}} is now verified. You can sign in.
verify.invalid: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
verify.missingSubtitle: This page needs a valid token.
verify.missingDescription: Open the link from your registration result, or create a new account.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a reset link.
forgot.note: For privacy, the response is the same whether or not an account exists.
forgot.sentSubtitle: If an account exists, a reset link is on its way.
forgot.sentTo: We processed a reset request for {{email}}.
forgot.demoDescription: The mock API returns the token instead of sending email, so you can finish the flow.
forgot.noAccountHint: No demo account matches this email. Try admin@fish.dev or register a new account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick a strong password you have not used before.
reset.successSubtitle: You can sign in with your new password.
reset.successDescription: All previous sessions were signed out.
reset.invalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
reset.missingSubtitle: This page needs a valid token.
reset.missingDescription: Request a new password reset link to continue.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.subtitle: Finish setting up your FishAdmin account.
invite.missingSubtitle: This page needs an invite token.
invite.missingDescription: Open the invitation link from your email to continue.
invite.invalidSubtitle: The link may have expired or already been used.
invite.invalidDescription: Ask an administrator for a new invitation.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.

otp.title: Two-step verification
otp.subtitle: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator.
otp.subtitleFor: Enter the code to finish signing in as {{email}}.
otp.description: Your account is protected with two-factor authentication.
otp.demoHint: Demo code: {{code}}. Fixed on purpose so the flow can be tested.
otp.expired: The code expired. Sign in again to get a new challenge.
otp.missingDescription: The challenge is created after your password is accepted.
